simple.meaning: gold , figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil , a clear sky
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זָהָב (H2091) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 389 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: זָהָב (zâhâb) means gold , figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil , a clear sky First listed occurrence: 1Chr 18 7.
